params.feedId: Nonzero identifier of the store feed.

params.requestedRoundId: Round identifier that must match the current source's latest round.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params.newSource: Replacement rate store or external aggregator.
params.newSourceFeedId: Store feed identifier, or zero for an external aggregator.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

constructor.notice: Initialize a store-backed feed without requiring a live source round.

decimals().notice: Return the fixed precision of the fiat/USD answer.

getRoundData(uint80).notice: Return the latest tuple only; historical rounds are not served.

latestRoundData().notice: Return the source's latest tuple unchanged, including invalid or stale rounds.

setSource(address,bytes32).notice: Switch to an eight-decimal source with a usable round no older than one day.

source().notice: Store or external aggregator supplying the latest round.

sourceFeedId().notice: Store feed identifier, or zero when the source is an external aggregator.

userdoc.notice: Chainlink-compatible facade for a fiat/USD feed with an owner-controlled source.
